thread:
Sam (sales): Quick help — prospect Kyvernion: ~1.2M initial users, SCIM push + 15m deltas, SAML + group->role RBAC. They want a ballpark if Hosted can handle it or we should recommend Dedicated. Also asked about BYOK and 12mo logs. Need a short answer for the buyer.

Aisha (solutions): Do they want bulk endpoint for initial import? Any estimate on changes/day?

Sam (sales): They said bulk for import, no churn numbers yet.

Diego (eng): Hosted tenant limits will likely throttle a 1.2M import. Recommend Dedicated reserved pool for the import (chunked Bulk calls 100-500). For steady small deltas Hosted is fine but initial ingest needs Dedicated or temp override.

Priya (security): BYOK/HSM and 12mo immutable logs are enterprise features — gated to Dedicated/Private. For POC we can offer managed KMS + enhanced logging and provide SOC2 summary.

Alex (sales_eng): Quick ballpark: Dedicated small pool $4k/mo, one-time migration support ~$7.5k, per-write ~$0.002. With 1.2M initial rough first-month total ~ $13-15k. I'll refine with churn.

Sam (sales): Great — I'll tell them Dedicated recommended for import, Hosted ok for steady-state, BYOK requires enterprise contract. Asking prospect for churn and admin-group naming now.
